en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground are traditional multi‑storey houses, a road junction and a small pavilion or gazebo. More houses, farm buildings and a church with a tall steeple are visible further back, with wooded hills in the distance. Printed German text appears at the bottom, and there is additional handwritten script along the lower margin.
